title: The Machine and the Brakes
subtitle: Europe is rearming, and it has done this before. The men who saw where it led were ignored, jailed and shot. A ghost story for 2026.
summary: Europe must rearm. But Jaurès, Bloch and Liebknecht warn that a war machine without democratic brakes begins to feed on itself.
hero_caption: Jaurès at Pré-Saint-Gervais, 25 May 1913, speaking against the three-year law. Photo: Maurice-Louis Branger. Wikimedia Commons.

title: Il pellicano e il fenicottero
subtitle: Come l’Albania ha imparato a difendere una laguna, e a smettere di fuggire verso l’Occidente
summary: La rivolta dei fenicotteri non è solo una protesta ambientale: è il momento in cui un paese abituato a inseguire l’Occidente impara a difendere ciò che non è in vendita.
hero_caption: Photo: Arben Llapashtica, Flamingos at Narta Lagoon, Albania, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0.

title: The Pelican and the Flamingo
subtitle: How Albania learned to defend a lagoon, and to stop fleeing West
summary: Albania’s flamingo protests are not just environmental. They mark a country that once fled toward the West learning to set conditions on what cannot be sold.
hero_caption: Photo: Arben Llapashtica, Flamingos at Narta Lagoon, Albania, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0.

title: Mismeasured
subtitle: Why does Europe keep being told that it is the one in decline?
summary: Europe's productivity gap with America is real. But the decline story measures output while ignoring lives, leisure and the welfare state — and risks fixing the wrong problem.
hero_caption: Inside an Amazon Logistics facility in Texas, 2020. Photograph released under CC0 via Wikimedia Commons.

title: The Returns
subtitle: Europe tested its deportation machine on my country. Last week it became the law of the continent.
summary: Italy's failed Albania detention experiment has become Europe's model for migration enforcement. Gjadër shows how failure can be scaled when the real goal is the performance of control.
hero_caption: Gjadër detention camp, Albania. Photo: Klodiana Millona, CC BY 2.0.

title: The Forbidden Island
subtitle: How Albania learned to say no
summary: Albania's fight over Sazan and the Vjosa-Narta coast is more than an environmental protest. It is a country that once said yes to everything learning to defend the commons.
hero_caption: Flamingo double-headed eagle illustration. Image provided by author.

title: The Back Office of Reparations
subtitle: What €193 billion in a Belgian custody account tells us about European power
summary: Europe has frozen Russia's money but not quite made Russia pay. The fight over Euroclear shows how reparations have become a test of whether European power can move from moral claim to financial decision.
hero_caption: Euroclear headquarters in Brussels. Photo: Marek Śliwecki/Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0; cropped.

title: A Suez Without a Sequel
subtitle: Europe at Hormuz, and the missing treaty
summary: Spain, Italy and France refused America its bases for a strike on Iran. That refusal echoes 1956, but Suez built the EEC because the plans were already on the table. This time, there is no draft.
hero_caption: Signing ceremony of the Treaty of Rome at the Palazzo dei Conservatori, Rome (1957).
